title: Per-route token sampler + delta-ingest pipeline for near-real-time billing
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Problem: Our current billing ingest relies on batch reconciles that run hourly and perform tenant-level aggregation across full ledgers. This results in poor near-real-time visibility for the Console, long feedback loops for customers, and high reconciliation cost.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce a per-route token sampling layer that emits deterministic deltas per request and route, preserving per-tenant attribution metadata (route, model, pricing-tier).
Implement a delta-ingest pipeline that consumes samplers and produces near-real-time token rollups (1-5 minute latency) without increasing downstream storage costs more than 12% in steady state.
End-to-end tests validate that sampled rollups converge to full ledgers within 24 hours with <0.5% drift for active tenants.
Console shows a new 'near-real-time' tab for billing that matches sampled rollups and reconciles to final invoices after daily batch runs.
Fallback: if sampler or delta pipeline fails, system continues to produce existing hourly-ledger outputs unchanged.
design_decisions: Deterministic sampling by route+model+tenant using hashing to ensure aggregations are idempotent across retries.
Emit deltas (tokens_used, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, request_id, route_id, model_variant) instead of full message payloads to limit bandwidth and storage.
Use an event-sourced Kafka topic 'metering.deltas' with compacted retention for near-real-time consumers, and a separate long-term shards topic for final daily rollups.
Trade-off: sampling rate defaults to 1% for high-QPS routes and 10% for low-QPS routes to balance accuracy and cost. We will tune rates per tenant during rollout.
We will not attempt to meter streaming token-by-token in this phase; streaming will be coarse-grained per stream session and refined in a follow-up.
Security: deltas exclude any user-generated content and include only metadata required for billing (no PII).
implementation_steps: 1) Add 'per-route sampler' module to routing layer that computes deterministic sample decision and emits delta to Kafka when sampled.
2) Build 'delta-ingest' Flink job to aggregate deltas by tenant+route+model in sliding-window (1m, 5m) and write to materialized rollup topic + ClickHouse for Console read paths.
3) Add reconciliation hook that schedules daily compare between sampled rollups and full ledgers, emitting correction records when drift detected.
4) Expose new near-real-time rollup APIs in Console backend and add feature flag for rollout per-tenant.
5) Performance and chaos testing in staging (simulated 10k QPS across tenants), load test the Kafka topic and Flink job, measure latency and cost.
6) Gradual rollout: internal tenants -> small beta customers -> broad opt-in -> default on for low-usage tenants.
7) Document API contract and update internal runbooks.
testing_plan: Unit tests: sampler deterministic hashing and idempotent delta emit semantics.
Integration tests: end-to-end flow from Router -> Kafka -> Flink -> ClickHouse with synthetic traffic generator.
Convergence tests: run 48-hour simulation to validate sampled rollups converge to daily ledger within 0.5% drift for active tenants.
A/B: run sampler for 10% of production tenants and compare Billing Console values vs baseline ledger over 7 days.
Failure mode tests: broker downtime, flink job restart, duplicate messages, and verify idempotency and compacted topic behavior.
rollout_plan: Feature flag gated at tenant level via Console toggle.
Phase 0 (internal): enable for 3 internal tenants, monitor costs & accuracy for 72 hours.
Phase 1 (beta): enable for 20 beta customers selected to span traffic profiles, monitor for 14 days.
Phase 2 (opt-in GA): open opt-in to all tenants with recommended default sampling rates and UI to request custom rates.
Phase 3 (default): evaluate cost/accuracy and flip to default for low usage tiers after 8 weeks if stable.
rollback_plan: If delta pipeline increases cost >20% or drift >2% for >5% of tenants in beta window, disable sampler via global flag and purge non-essential topics.
If Flink job instability causes >1% request failures, scale down sampling rates to zero and fall back to hourly batch path.
Provide automated backfill job to run sampled-only tenants through full ledger path if data loss suspected.
Notify customers in beta via status page and open support tickets when rollback occurs.

2025-11-28 | Marco Ruiz: Updated design — we will shard by tenant-hash and compact topics; added low-QPS higher-sample-rate heuristic to keep variance down.
